messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert PD-84291 fired -> host: gpu-host-47 (us-east-2a). Reason: node_unresponsive + kernel_panic suspected. Paging oncall. https://pd.company/incidents/PD-84291 :rotating_light:

mara (oncall): acknowledging, on it. pinging serial console and kube-node status.

pagerduty-bot: PD-84291 acknowledged by mara. Escalation window starts in 8m if not resolved.

mara (oncall): `kubectl get nodes gpu-host-47 -o wide` shows NODE STATUS: NotReady, no kubelet heartbeat for 2m. can't reach kubelet on 10.12.47.3.

joel: looking at rack metrics — BMC is flapping, serial console not responding. I see an XID error on the last kernel msg: `nv_gpu: Xid 62: MMU fault` in system logs from 30s before last heartbeat.

mara (oncall): copying logs from console buffer:```
[  123.456789] Kernel panic - not syncing: fatal exception
[  123.456790] CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted
[  123.456791] RIP: 0010:gpu_driver_fault+0x2a3/0x400
```

kevin (sre-shadow): that looks like a driver NV/KMD crash loop. Could be 535.21 driver regression. Any recent bundle upgrades on that rack?

dan (infra): Not aware of scheduled upgrades. I'll try a soft powercycle via IPMI but will only do it after we confirm running workloads. Mara, can you check node's assigned tenants?

mara (oncall): checking. `rclone` of cluster metadata: gpu-host-47 had 3 live pods from tenant "voice-api-prod": 2 inference replicas on model "redwood-bert-large" and 1 batch encode job. Active requests for that tenant went to 503 at ~12:41:23 UTC.

joel: customer impact: voice-api-prod error rate spike ~5% for last 3m, p50 latency unaffected for others. Not a global outage but nontrivial for that tenant.

mara (oncall): marking customer-impact: yes (partial). Notifying customer success: @cs-team via escalation channel.

dan (infra): initiating ipmi soft-reset now (will wait 30s). If no serial, I'll force powercycle.

pagerduty-bot: PD-84291 escalated to infra after no auto-resolve in 8m.

incidentbot: action log: mara cordoned node gpu-host-47 -> `kubectl cordon gpu-host-47` then created eviction drain for non-critical pods:```
kubectl drain gpu-host-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=30 --timeout=5m
```

mara (oncall): drain started, eviction progressing. Two inference pods were rebalanced to gpu-pool-3, one batch job killed (will retry).

joel: customer-rate graph shows dropped requests resumed after rebalancing; errors reduced to baseline within 90s of pod reschedule. Good.

dan (infra): host came back to life after IPMI powercycle. Serial console shows POST ok but OS won't complete boot — stuck in kernel oops loop referencing nvkm. Trying kernel fallback to previous init.

kevin (sre-shadow): recommend we mark this node for RMA and remove from pool until we can repro on staging. I'll open ticket with hw-team.

mara (oncall): agreed. Setting node taint `redwood/needs-rma=true:NoSchedule` so autoscaler won't put tenants back.

joel: updating status -> PD incident comment: partial customer impact, node cordoned/drained, rma requested, mitigation: rescheduled pods; follow-up: investigate GPU driver version + kernel compatibility on rack-7.

incidentbot: PD-84291 resolved (manual) by mara at 2025-11-07T12:58:18Z. Notes: service degraded for tenant voice-api-prod for ~3m; no broader platform impact.

mara (oncall): handing off to next oncall @dan for hardware RMA tracking and root-cause follow-up. Leaving detailed notes in ops-runbook. :white_check_mark:

dan (infra): taking handoff. I'll open hw RMA + schedule node repro in staging.

kevin (sre-shadow): we'll also run a cluster-wide driver health check and create a scheduled job to surface nodes with Xid errors.

mara (oncall): thanks all. closing thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
